claim_ceiling: ADR-0344 Proposed/advisory manifest declaration only; no runtime instrumentation, measured emissions, live billing, OpenCost/FOCUS export, generated JSON, or production FinOps readiness claim.

workload_signal_source.source_ref: active workflow execution, step execution, replay, timer, and worker dispatch paths

power_model.derivation_note: Values are fixture coefficients selected from workflow-engine's Tier-0 per_workflow_run capacity model, 12 GiB storage baseline, high outbound worker/event-bus surface, and workflow-step latency SLO; they are not ADR example coefficients and not measured production calibration.

price_model.non_claim: Fixture binds to provider SKU pricing authority only; no invoice, chargeback, or live cost allocation mutation is performed.

review_notes.no_carbon_deferral: Tier 0 workflow execution and tenant-authored plugin surfaces are explicitly ineligible for carbon-aware deferral under ADR-0344 B2/D-9.
review_notes.security_tenant_data_plane: Tenant-authored workflow/custom-node execution keeps this in the strongest isolation lane.
review_notes.audit_chain: Emission attribution follows workflow-execute/replay seal events; failure to populate the five ADR-0344 audit-row fields must fail the future emission-path gate.

failure_cases: workflow run audit row missing provider/region/cost/co2/watt_hours
billing mutation attempted during fixture replay

recalibration.evidence_floor: representative workflow-step resource-accounting sample plus independent power-model validation before any measured claim
